description: Exact port of nera-data-layer bootstrap_cache_health at 2b1504adc4291daaf080b2e932962b134da1a69a.

stages.name: a
stages.query: SELECT __path,ast_kind AS kind,ast_name AS name,NULL AS alias,NULL AS module,NULL AS value,NULL AS value_kind,CAST(NULLIF(ast_preorder,'') AS INTEGER) AS id,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS bfs,CAST(NULLIF(ast_parent,'') AS INTEGER) AS parent,ast_field AS field,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS position,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS last,CAST(NULLIF(ast_function,'') AS INTEGER) AS fn,NULL AS op,CAST(NULLIF(ast_start,'') AS INTEGER) AS __start,CAST(NULLIF(ast_stop,'') AS INTEGER) AS __end,CAST(NULLIF(ast_line,'') AS INTEGER) AS line,NULL AS context,NULL AS name_repr,NULL AS value_repr,NULL AS annotation,NULL AS annotation_repr FROM canonical

stages.name: calls
stages.query:
SELECT c.*,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.name AS callee,f.id AS callee_id,r.id AS receiver,r.kind AS receiver_kind,r.name AS receiver_name
      FROM a c JOIN a f ON f.__path=c.__path AND f.parent=c.id AND f.field='func'
      LEFT JOIN a r ON r.__path=f.__path AND r.parent=f.id AND r.field='value'
      WHERE c.kind='Call'

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT * FROM a WHERE kind IN ('FunctionDef','AsyncFunctionDef')

stages.name: qualified
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE q(__path,id,name) AS (
      SELECT __path,id,name FROM a WHERE kind='Name'
      UNION ALL SELECT p.__path,p.id,CASE WHEN p.kind='Attribute' THEN q.name||'.'||p.name ELSE q.name END
      FROM q JOIN a child ON child.__path=q.__path AND child.id=q.id
      JOIN a p ON p.__path=child.__path AND p.id=child.parent
      WHERE p.kind='Attribute' AND child.field='value' OR p.kind='Call' AND child.field='func') SELECT * FROM q

stages.name: cache_calls
stages.query:
SELECT c.*,CASE WHEN substr(f.name,1,5)='test_' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a d JOIN qualified q ON q.__path=d.__path AND q.id=d.id WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.parent=f.id AND d.field='decorator_list' AND (q.name='fixture' OR substr(q.name,-14)='pytest.fixture')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS inside_test
 FROM calls c LEFT JOIN functions f ON f.__path=c.__path AND f.id=c.fn
 JOIN cst s ON s.__path=c.__path AND s.kind='call' AND s.__start=c.__start AND s.__end=c.__end
 JOIN call_lines l ON l.__path=s.__path AND l.id=s.id
 WHERE instr(l.source_line,'bootstrap-cache-health: allow')=0 AND instr(l.previous_line,'bootstrap-cache-health: allow')=0

relational.query: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'BCH001' AS issue,n.callee||'() inside a test/fixture can create repeated cold bootstraps; prefer module-level TEST_BOOTSTRAP_TABLES or TEST_BOOTSTRAP_VERSIONING_DOMAINS' AS message,n.id||':BCH001:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM cache_calls n WHERE n.inside_test AND n.callee IN ('bootstrap_test_logged_tables_for_tests','bootstrap_test_logged_tables_for_tests_async','bootstrap_test_queues_for_tests','bootstrap_test_queues_for_tests_async','bootstrap_test_schema_for_tests','bootstrap_test_schema_for_tests_async','bootstrap_test_table_triggers_for_tests','bootstrap_test_table_triggers_for_tests_async','bootstrap_test_tables_for_tests','bootstrap_test_tables_for_tests_async','bootstrap_test_versioning_domain_for_tests','bootstrap_test_versioning_domain_for_tests_async') UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'BCH002' AS issue,n.callee||'() uses an explicit manifest_key; per-test manifest keys commonly cause BOOT-WARM-CACHE-MISS' AS message,n.id||':BCH002:'||(n.id+0.0001) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id+0.0001 AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM cache_calls n WHERE n.callee IN ('bootstrap_test_logged_tables_for_tests','bootstrap_test_logged_tables_for_tests_async','bootstrap_test_queues_for_tests','bootstrap_test_queues_for_tests_async','bootstrap_test_schema_for_tests','bootstrap_test_schema_for_tests_async','bootstrap_test_table_triggers_for_tests','bootstrap_test_table_triggers_for_tests_async','bootstrap_test_tables_for_tests','bootstrap_test_tables_for_tests_async','bootstrap_test_versioning_domain_for_tests','bootstrap_test_versioning_domain_for_tests_async') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a v WHERE v.__path=n.__path AND v.parent=n.id AND v.field='keywords' AND (v.name='manifest_key')) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'BCH003' AS issue,n.callee||'() inside a conform test usually causes a warm schema mutation; prefer module-level TEST_BOOTSTRAP_TABLES' AS message,n.id||':BCH003:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM cache_calls n WHERE n.inside_test AND n.callee_kind='Name' AND n.callee IN ('create_table','create_tables')

SELECT i.__path path,0 start_byte,0 end_byte,1 line,'BCH000' issue,'SyntaxError: '||json_extract(p.syntax_error,'$.msg')||CASE WHEN json_extract(p.syntax_error,'$.lineno') IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ' ('||rx_replace(i.__path,'^.*/','')||', line '||json_extract(p.syntax_error,'$.lineno')||')' END message,i.__path identity,0 phase,0 ordering,'' symbol,'' sort_name FROM invalid i JOIN parsed p ON p.__path=i.__path WHERE p.syntax_error!='null'
